name: pwsh
description: Run a PowerShell command in this conversation or an explicit workdir. For file organization, use Move-Item -LiteralPath with explicit destinations and skip existing destinations; do not use -Force to replace user files unless requested. Directory creation is ordinary; deleting or overwriting user files requires native approval.

name: read
description: Read a file. Relative paths use this conversation directory.

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch the first captured section of a URL with its outline. For partial pages, load browser and read only relevant further segments by snapshotId; do not refetch or cite unread sections. The browser has two concurrent page slots; fetch independent sources in pairs. Match the requested deliverable: a brief explanation should use a few paragraphs to summarize the main supported changes and source links, without an exhaustive audit, full changelogs, raw dependency files or unrequested migration recipes and build instructions. State the comparison basis; distinguish initial major releases from current maintained minor releases and do not label backported features as exclusive to a newer major. A release-note deprecation label does not establish replacement syntax; runtime build requirements do not apply automatically to third-party extensions. Omit unsupported claims. Once the requested facts are supported, save the requested brief document and read it back to verify. Confirm its purpose and base filename in plain text, with source links.
